linhas.txt: Yuck! Ar sujo, água suja, chão sujo! POLLUTION é quando a gente suja o planeta com lixo e químicos — e são TRÊS tipos: air, water and land! Grab your pencil — vem comigo aprender como ESCREVER sobre isso e como parar. You can do it!
POLLUTION igual a when the environment is contaminated (made dirty) by waste, chemicals and harmful substances. THREE main forms:
AIR pollution — mostly from BURNING FOSSIL FUELS. Causes acid rain and global warming.
WATER pollution — dumping garbage and sewage in rivers/oceans; farm chemicals (fertilizers, pesticides).
LAND pollution — LITTERING (throwing trash on the ground) and dangerous chemicals in the soil. It destroys habitats (homes of plants and animals).
WRITING TIP: organise in paragraphs, use linking words (first, also, finally), capital letters and full stops. Say the PROBLEM and give a SOLUTION ('We should...', 'We can recycle...').
